span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Intensity tuning arises because the excitatory/inhibitory balance shifts with sound level: at high intensities the filtered inputs land on the saturating part of the internal nonlinearities, so the excitatory lead no longer produces a large net drive.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Onset responses are generated by excitation reaching the cell before inhibition, with the lagging inhibition cutting the response short.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Offset responses are generated when the excitatory nonlinearity is amplified relative to the inhibitory one, so inhibition falls away before excitation does and firing rebounds.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Sustained firing is generated when, at large filter outputs, the internal nonlinearity amplifies excitation more than inhibition.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: transient onset responses arise from inhibition arriving later than excitation, and also from a difference in their nonlinear gains even when the latencies match
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: offset responses are described as rebound from inhibition, in the 15% of neurons that show them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and intensity tuning falls out of the separate nonlinearities, which shift the balance between excitation and inhibition as intensity and stimulus dynamics change
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the whole approach resting on approximating the mechanisms rather than the response properties

span.label: The model's excitatory and inhibitory terms cannot be claimed to correspond to actual synaptic currents or conductances.
span.note: what this limits: every interpretation of the model's terms as physiology: THE LABELS FOR EACH TERM ARE MEANT TO DESCRIBE THE INTUITION BEHIND THE STRUCTURE OF THE MODEL, BUT WE CANNOT CLAIM THAT THESE TERMS NECESSARILY REPRESENT ACTUAL excitatory and inhibitory currents
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The model's constrained structure sacrifices generality and may perform poorly for nonlinearities it does not embody.
span.note: what this limits: the model's performance outside the nonlinearities it encodes: THIS LACK OF GENERALITY COULD HURT THE GNM PERFORMANCE WHEN CONSIDERING NONLINEAR PROCESSING OF FORMS NOT CAPTURED BY ITS STRUCTURE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The current model cannot represent separate offset-tuned inputs as an alternative source of offset responses.

span.label: The fit does not prove that the proposed nonlinear mechanisms actually produce the observed A1 nonlinearities.
span.note: what this limits: the mechanistic reading of the model fit: ALTHOUGH THIS IS BY NO MEANS PROOF THAT SUCH NONLINEAR MECHANISMS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR OBSERVED A1 NONLINEARITIES, IT DOES PROVIDE A UNIFIED FRAMEWORK

span.label: the fit is explicitly not proof that these mechanisms are responsible for the observed nonlinearities
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as limitations[3], from the other direction: THERE IS NO GUARANTEE THAT FOCUSING ON INTERNAL NONLINEAR MECHANISMS WOULD NECESSARILY DESCRIBE THE OBSERVED RESPONSE NONLINEARITIES, WE FOUND THAT THEY DID

span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHETHER THE NONLINEARITY IS DISCOVERED FROM THE DATA. 'One approach has been to identify additional stimulus features (in addition to the linear STRF) that contribute to the computation underlying the neuronal response, for example using SPIKE-TRIGGERED COVARIANCE (STC) or MAXIMALLY INFORMATIVE DIMENSION (MID) ANALYSIS.' Its twin at [6] carries the other family, which builds in nonlinearities chosen in advance. NOTE: the target also calls these methods 'more general and less interpretable' AND THIS SPAN SAYS NEITHER - the axis recorded here is the one the sentence supports, and the target's extra claim remains unanchored.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: distinguishes-from → multilinear models that add components for specific known nonlinearities
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHETHER THE NONLINEARITY IS DISCOVERED OR SPECIFIED IN ADVANCE. 'A second approach has taken an opposite tack, by incorporating model components to capture specific nonlinear elements of A1 processing, such as intensity tuning and dependence on stimulus context. This approach has been CAST AS A MULTILINEAR MODEL.' One family searches for features the data reveal; the other builds in nonlinearities the modeller already believes in - so the two can fit the same neuron and disagree about what it does.
